patterns.note: A full-bleed, immersive media reel is presented as the primary content, with individual video or image clips separated by thin black horizontal bars, creating a cinematic sequence.
A high-contrast color scheme is used, primarily featuring a vibrant red, deep black, and the natural tones of the photographic/video content.
An initial full-screen red intro panel with the brand name slides upwards on scroll, acting as a curtain to reveal the continuous, full-bleed video and image sequence beneath it.
A subtle numerical scroll progress indicator is displayed at the bottom of the initial intro screen, updating as the user scrolls.
The brand name is presented in an extremely large, bold, uppercase sans-serif font, creating a strong visual statement that contrasts with the smaller, refined uppercase navigation text.

technique_notes: The site employs a full-screen, static intro panel that acts as a visual curtain. On scroll, this panel animates by sliding upwards, revealing a continuous, full-bleed sequence of video clips and high-resolution images that fill the viewport.
Navigation elements appear with a subtle fade-in or slide-down effect once the initial intro panel has scrolled out of view, maintaining a clean aesthetic during the initial experience.
A numerical scroll progress indicator is dynamically updated at the bottom of the initial intro screen, providing subtle feedback on scroll depth.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold display text (~8x body) for the brand name, contrasting with small, refined uppercase navigation.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy on the intro screen, transitioning to dense full-bleed media sections with minimal separation.

standout: The site's distinctive design lies in its dramatic, full-screen red intro that acts as a 'curtain reveal,' transitioning into an immersive, cinematic video and image reel on scroll. This creates a highly theatrical and experiential brand introduction.
